name: research decision tree
status: adopted by the convenor, October 21, 2026; room discussion pending
role: Controller over the modes of inquiry. Reads the record (Cleland's H + A + C => E, with Q and O) and calls the next mode. Graph v0.4.2 is the vocabulary inside each mode.

outcomes.success: A conclusion is reached: a claim kept with its status, a rival excluded, or a claim contradicted. A contradicted claim is a successful result.
outcomes.failure: No conclusion is reached after the question has been reframed.

start: Start: a question, an anomaly, data, a capability, or a goal

questions.sub: It repeats, and it is not an artifact of the measurement chain.

branches.label: no: the chain is suspect
branches.name: Instruments · methods
branches.note: characterize the chain

branches.label: no: not yet stable
branches.name: Exploration
branches.note: vary conditions until it repeats

questions.sub: Or is it a latent quantity behind the data?

branches.label: no
branches.name: Estimation
branches.note: invert through a forward model; state resolution

questions.sub: A mechanism, a relation, a forecast, or a pooled estimate.

branches.label: a relation
branches.name: Regularities
branches.note: fit across repetitions; test out of sample

branches.label: a forecast
branches.name: Simulation
branches.note: freeze the forecast; compare when the outcome arrives

branches.label: a pooled estimate
branches.name: Cross-study synthesis
branches.note: state the inclusion rule; model dependence between studies

questions.sub: Incompatible explanations, with "artifact" kept as one.

branches.label: no
branches.name: Theory · hypothesis
branches.note: generate rivals; record how each was generated

questions.q: Does each rival predict something different?
questions.sub: An expectation for each rival, from H + A + C.

branches.label: no
branches.name: Theory · simulation
branches.note: derive or compute each expectation

branches.label: still identical
branches.name: A new observable
branches.note: a capability that separates the rivals

questions.sub: Experiment, or conditions found in nature.

branches.label: yes
branches.name: Hypothesis assessment
branches.note: design the test, set the conditions, observe, compare

branches.label: no: nature repeats it
branches.name: Regularities
branches.note: nature's repetition

branches.label: no: one event
branches.name: Reconstruction from traces
branches.note: independent traces of the same event; rival histories

questions.sub: Replication and robustness (V): vary the auxiliaries A and the conditions C; independent data, methods, models.

branches.label: no: an auxiliary is wrong
branches.name: Protect
branches.note: revise A instead of H; logged; must predict something new (cap: open)

questions.sub: Keep, exclude, contradict: each is a conclusion.

branches.label: survivors remain
branches.name: Refine
branches.note: split the survivors into subhypotheses

branches.label: no rival fits
branches.name: Surprise
branches.note: an outcome no rival predicted: explore it

branches.label: no conclusion
branches.name: Question-driven inquiry
branches.note: reframe the question; record why the first framing could not be answered

branches.label: still none after reframing
branches.name: Failure, recorded
branches.note: name the observation that would decide

branches.label: a new control asked for
branches.name: Robustness
branches.note: run it; it usually enters as a planned-looking figure

branches.label: a new rival named
branches.name: Hypothesis assessment
branches.note: test it, or state why it is excluded

branches.label: the claim is too broad
branches.name: Refine the claim
branches.note: narrow it to what the evidence carries

branches.label: the request is declined
branches.name: Argue and log
branches.note: keep the design; record the reason

end: Conclusion: keep, exclude, or contradict the claim, with its status, and publish the record, the path including its loops, and the evidence the mode owes.
caption: The research decision tree, v0.5.1 (adopted by the convenor; room discussion pending). Questions about the record run down the left; each answer that sends the work elsewhere calls a mode (right, with the graph nodes it runs) and returns to the question marked ↺. Every route that produces evidence reaches question 7, robustness, before the verdict. A project fails only when no conclusion is reached after the question has been reframed.
open: A numeric cap on protective revisions (P): undecided.

changelog.change: First tree: eight questions over the record; review added as question 9 after the process-document test.

Convenor decisions: adopted as the controller over graph v0.4.2; reframing (question-driven inquiry) after no conclusion; failure = no conclusion, a contradicted claim is a success; synthesis split into cross-study synthesis (question 3) and reconstruction from traces (question 6b); protection cap left open.
